front: When and where was poison gas first used on a large scale?
When did the Battle of Verdun begin?
back: 21 February 1916, with a German attack on the French.

front: How many British casualties were there on the first day of the Somme?
back: About 57,000, nearly 20,000 of them killed (1 July 1916).

front: When and where were tanks first used?
back: 15 September 1916, by the British, on the Somme.

front: Give the two sides of the debate about Haig.
back: Critics: he wasted lives at the Somme and Passchendaele. Defenders: he supported France, wore Germany down and won in 1918.

front: Why did attacks so often fail on the Western Front?
back: Bombardments warned the enemy and failed to cut wire; machine guns and artillery cut down infantry; reserves arrived by rail to plug gaps.
